svg.title: Colocated mail latency: fine-grained wall-time sunburst
svg.desc: Concurrent filesystem and VM work is represented separately, so every millisecond is counted once. Rings show wall owner, subsystem, and operation.

g.text: Colocated mailbox · fresh measured send · trial 2 · explicit selection from 7 sends
Contact lookup 0.0 ms → Send / notification 477.2 ms

g.text: Read the rings outward: wall-time owner → subsystem / request → operation.
Filesystem + VM sectors are simultaneous work, not extra time added to either total.
Other includes IPC, scheduling, instrumentation and host work not covered by explicit spans.
Execution includes promise jobs. Finalizer callbacks are separate from garbage collection.
Service endpoint only: HTTP, browser rendering and screen presentation are excluded.
